# The regional ledger closes at the end of June

## Context Scope

Posting to the EMEA regional ledger.

## Fact Statement

The regional ledger accepts postings until the end of June and is read-only after.

## Why This Matters

It replaces the earlier plan to keep the ledger open through September.
